posts.title: AI Is Going Away
posts.description: The releases of Stable Diffusion and ChatGPT in late 2022 shoved AI into the forefront of society. This has spawned a variety of discourse, with “executive hypemen” such as Sam Altman extolling its graces, skeptics like Gary Marcus scrutinizing its trajectory, and still others raving about how it’s going to kill us all next Tuesday—some with undue enthusiasm.
